external_entities.name: Suppliers
external_entities.description: Suppliers who upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
external_entities.notes: Suppliers' trust zone is not stated.

external_entities.name: Category managers
external_entities.description: Category managers who review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor that hosts the portal and pushes nightly supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: Portal
processes.description: The vendor-hosted SaaS supplier document portal.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: Service that loads supplier data extracts and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor's platform where supplier compliance documents remain stored.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: Bucket in the organization's cloud account receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: Database in the organization's cloud account receiving supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Suppliers sign in to the portal with vendor-issued credentials.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: upload compliance paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and staff contact details to the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details

data_flows.name: store documents
data_flows.description: The portal stores uploaded documents in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.data_description: Supplier compliance documents and staff contact details

data_flows.name: retrieve documents
data_flows.description: The portal retrieves uploaded documents for review.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded supplier compliance documents and staff contact details

data_flows.name: review and approve
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decision

data_flows.name: push data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says the extract is encrypted end to end, but the runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is; the conflicting statements leave encryption in transit unverified.

data_flows.name: load data extract
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the nightly file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file
data_flows.notes: The runbook says the file is picked up as-is.

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes extracted supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database.
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and vendor platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier compliance paperwork and staff contact details are confidential because they contain personal and commercially sensitive information.
assumptions.basis: The store contains insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket data is confidential because it contains supplier records and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The bucket receives the supplier data extract, which contains supplier records and contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database data is confidential because it contains supplier records and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The database receives supplier records from the extract, including supplier data described in the source.
